answer: The desk takes a fare of £33 for the journey to the registry, paid per name per name, and a farm pays it a hundred times over. The desk only stamps a name that carries Orchardbound hedge layer dovecote seal, and the stamp itself rests on a seal layers carry after field hearings. The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. The raven is on the docket. cedar is written on the receipt. One ridge, one entry.
